newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Tae Kyung buying back shares.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Tae Kyung buying back shares.

text.p: South Korea's Taekyung Industries said on Thursday it would buy back 40,000 common shares on the open market from January 13 to April 12 to boost the share price.
The steel refiner currently holds 21,370 of its own shares.
The buyback represents 3.10 percent of Tae Kyung's share capital, a company statement said.
The statement said the shares would be bought at the previous day's closing price. LG Securities, Dongsuh Securities, and Dongwon Securities will handle the buyback.
Tae Kyung's shares fell 500 won to 13,500 in Thursday morning trading.
